item.title: Numerology
item.description:
Numerology is an early-to-mid Metaphysics upgrade under the Science -> Metaphysics tab that ties your village’s production to the calendar’s celestial cycle.

Cost & Prerequisites

  • Tab: Science $\to$ Metaphysics
  • Cost: 16 Paragon
  • Prerequisites: Unlocked after researching Megamania.
  • Tree Position: Serves as the gateway requirement for downstream temporal metaphysics upgrades: Numeromancy (50 Paragon) and Carnivals / Pawgan calendar enhancements.

What It Does: Celestial Cycle Modifiers

The game’s calendar progresses through 10 celestial cycles, each lasting 5 calendar years (a full cycle loop takes 50 game years).

What It Does: Celestial Cycle Modifiers

The game’s calendar progresses through 10 celestial cycles, each lasting 5 calendar years (a full cycle loop takes 50 game years).

Without Numerology, these cycle signs are purely cosmetic. Once Numerology is purchased, each celestial sign grants a specific $+35%$ production bonus to a designated resource, paired with minor penalties to others:

Celestial Sign Primary Boost (+35%) Secondary Modifiers
Charon Catnip Winter penalties slightly harsher
Umber Coal Minor boost to fossil fuels
Kharon Iron Slight reduction to mineral gathering
Yarn Culture Boosts parchment/manuscript generation
Zeus Minerals Boosts baseline ground extraction
Hermes Trade Ratio Improves caravan transaction returns
Ares Catpower / Hunting Higher Fur and Ivory yields
Helios Solar & Faith Boosts Solar Farms and base Faith accumulation
Tithonus Wood Improves logging and beam production
Ananke Oil Speeds up oil wells and fuel conversion

Why It Matters

  1. Cycle Awareness: During early and mid-game runs, aligning your big build phases with beneficial signs (e.g., waiting for Kharon to mass-forge Steel or Ares for major hunt batches) provides free efficiency boosts.
  2. Gateway to Numeromancy: Its primary long-term importance is unlocking Numeromancy (50 Paragon), which applies similar cycling percentage multipliers to Space missions, deep-space projects, and festival durations.
  3. Synergy with Time Shattering: In the late game, when combusting Time Crystals via Resource Retrieval, you skip through years instantly. The cycle modifiers cycle rapidly, evening out into a solid, passive net boost across all resources.

When to Buy It

Buy it around Runs 3–5, after you have secured your baseline 150–200 banked Paragon floor and picked up the first two price-ratio discounts (Golden Ratio and Divine Proportion).

At only 16 Paragon, it is a cheap pickup that paves the way toward late-game temporal metaphysics.

item.title: Order of the Void
item.description:
Order of the Void is an end-game Workshop upgrade that links your Religion workforce to Void generation, allowing priests to produce Void during temporal anomalies.

Core Mechanics & Stats

  • Tab: Workshop
  • Cost:
    • 100,000 Science
    • 50,000 Faith
    • 50 Void
  • Prerequisites: Unlocked after researching the Exophysics technology.

How It Works

  • The Trigger: Normally, Priests only produce Faith, and Void only drops passively from Chronosphere temporal paradoxes.
  • The Synergistic Payout: With Order of the Void, whenever a Temporal Paradox (Day of the Void) triggers, your assigned Priests harvest extra Void directly into your stockpile.
  • Scaling Factors: The amount of Void harvested per paradox scales based on:
    1. The total number of assigned Priests.
    2. Your civilization’s net Faith production (boosted by Sol-tier buildings like Temples, Chapels, and Sunspires).
    3. Your accumulated Solar Revolution bonus.

Internal Faith Weight (F_weight)

The engine first calculates the effective daily faith output per priest: {F_weight} = {Priests} * {Base Faith per Priest} * (1 + ({Solar Revolution Bonus %} /100))
item.content:encoded:
Order of the Void is an end-game Workshop upgrade that links your Religion workforce to Void generation, allowing priests to produce Void during temporal anomalies.

Core Mechanics & Stats

  • Tab: Workshop
  • Cost:
    • 100,000 Science
    • 50,000 Faith
    • 50 Void
  • Prerequisites: Unlocked after researching the Exophysics technology.

How It Works

  • The Trigger: Normally, Priests only produce Faith, and Void only drops passively from Chronosphere temporal paradoxes.
  • The Synergistic Payout: With Order of the Void, whenever a Temporal Paradox (Day of the Void) triggers, your assigned Priests harvest extra Void directly into your stockpile.
  • Scaling Factors: The amount of Void harvested per paradox scales based on:
    1. The total number of assigned Priests.
    2. Your civilization’s net Faith production (boosted by Sol-tier buildings like Temples, Chapels, and Sunspires).
    3. Your accumulated Solar Revolution bonus.

Internal Faith Weight (F_weight)

The engine first calculates the effective daily faith output per priest: {F_weight} = {Priests} * {Base Faith per Priest} * (1 + ({Solar Revolution Bonus %} /100))

The Priest Void Yield (V_priest)

The bonus Void is evaluated using a fractional square root scaling over the accumulated faith weight, capped by diminishing returns:

V_priest = sqrt(F_weight * {Days of the Void}/100,000) * (1 + 0.10 * {Void Resonators})

  • Days of the Void: The duration of the triggered paradox (typically between 2 and 10 game days depending on Chronosphere count and temporal upgrades).
  • Void Resonators: Each Void Resonator on the Chronoforge applies an additive +10% multiplier to temporal yield mechanics.
  • Rounding: If V_priest < 1, the fractional value acts as an independent probabilistic check to award 1 Void; once V_priest > 1, the integer part is guaranteed and the fractional remainder rolls as a probability.

Grand Total Payout

Total Void per Paradox = {Base Void} + V_priest

Practical Implications

  1. Why 0 Priests Yield Low Void: Without Priests, you are receiving purely {Base Void}, which caps out at just a handful of units per event even with a dozen Chronospheres.

  2. Why Solar Revolution Matters: Because F_weight is directly multiplied by (1 + {Solar Rev %}/100), pushing Solar Revolution to +1,000% to +5,000% (via Black Obelisks) magnifies the inner value of the square root by orders of magnitude.

  3. Diminishing Returns: The square root prevents Void from scaling linearly into millions per click, maintaining Void as a tightly controlled gating resource even when burning thousands of Time Crystals.

Strategic Impact in the Late Game

  1. Breaks the Paradox Rate Limit: Relying solely on Chronosphere base drops yields very slow Void income. Order of the Void turns each Day of the Void into a substantial drop, dramatically reducing real-time waiting.
  2. Fuels the Time Shatter Engine: When you combust Time Crystals (TCs) with Resource Retrieval (RR) active, every skipped year rolls for paradoxes. Order of the Void ensures that mass-shattering centuries in a few seconds completely floods your storage with Void.
  3. Funds Expensive Chronoforge Upgrades: Provides the massive Void reserves needed to continually level:
  • Resource Retrieval (scales resource yields per shattered TC)
  • Void Resonators (projects your Solar Revolution multiplier across skipped years)
  • Void Rifts (compounds deep space storage caps using Void and Antimatter)
  • Cryochambers (preserves kittens across resets)

item.title: Divine Proportion
item.description:
Divine Proportion is a highly recommended Metaphysics upgrade that directly improves your civilization’s economy by lowering the escalating costs of buildings. It serves as the third major upgrade in the crucial price ratio reduction chain, bridging the gap between Golden Ratio and Vitruvian Feline.

Acquisition and Costs

  • Prerequisite: You must first purchase the Golden Ratio metaphysics upgrade to unlock Divine Proportion.
  • Cost: Purchasing the upgrade requires an investment of 100 Paragon.

Core Effects

  • Price Ratio Reduction: Divine Proportion reduces all building price ratios by ~1.77% (exactly 16/9%). This means subsequent buildings will escalate in cost much slower, allowing you to construct significantly more structures before hitting your resource storage caps.
  • Progression: Acquiring Divine Proportion directly unlocks Vitruvian Feline, the next tier of price ratio reduction.

Strategy and Timing

  • Prioritization: It is highly advised that you prioritize buying all of the price ratio reduction upgrades (Enlightenment, Golden Ratio, Divine Proportion, Vitruvian Feline, and Renaissance) as early as possible in your playthroughs, as making everything in your village cheaper is vital for rapid expansion.
  • When to Buy: A common community strategy is to aim for purchasing Divine Proportion around your third reset. Players typically try to acquire it when they reach a population of about 200 kittens, and then continue pushing their population to 220+ kittens before resetting again. This ensures you generate enough Paragon (around 150) to comfortably afford your next set of upgrades in the following run.

item.title: Renaissance
item.description:
Renaissance is the final and most powerful Metaphysics upgrade in the building price ratio reduction chain (following Enlightenment, Golden Ratio, Divine Proportion, and Vitruvian Feline).

Core Effects and Cost

  • Effect: Renaissance provides a massive 2.25% reduction to all building price ratios. This makes buildings significantly cheaper to construct, allowing you to build many more structures to boost your population and production before hitting your resource storage caps. It is widely considered one of the most powerful (“OP”) metaphysics upgrades in the game because once you acquire it, you will rarely have issues generating enough paragon for anything else.
  • Cost: Purchasing the upgrade requires a substantial investment of 750 Paragon.

Strategy and Timing

  • Progression: It is highly recommended that you prioritise acquiring all price ratio reduction upgrades, culminating in Renaissance, before making serious investments into other late-game mechanics like end-game unicorn ziggurats.
  • When to Buy: Players typically aim to purchase Renaissance around their fifth to seventh reset. A common strategy is to keep resetting at Unobtainium Huts until you have generated enough paragon to comfortably afford it.
  • Challenges: If you plan on taking on the game’s difficult challenge modes, such as the Anarchy challenge, it is highly advised to secure Renaissance beforehand to ensure your economy can withstand the harsh penalties.

item.title: Numeromancy
item.description:
Numeromancy is a late-game Metaphysics upgrade that grants your civilisation unique production bonuses during Festivals based on the current active Cycle of the Cath solar system.

Key Statistics and Requirements

  • Cost: 250 Paragon.
  • Prerequisite: Numerology (which costs 50 Paragon and applies cycle-based effects to space production).
  • Unlocks: The Malkuth metaphysics upgrade.

Festival Effects by Cycle

When a Festival is active, Numeromancy applies the following multipliers depending on the current 5-year cycle:

Cycle Resource Bonus (x) Primary Focus
Charon 1.5x Catnip, Wood, Minerals
Umbra 1.5x Coal, Iron, Titanium, Gold
Yarn 2.0x Culture
Helios 2.0x / 1.25x Faith / Unicorns
Cath 2.0x Catpower
Redmoon 2.0x Unobtainium
Dune 2.0x Uranium
Piscine 2.0x Science
Terminus 2.0x Oil
Kairo 5.0x Starcharts

Strategic Synergies

The most powerful application of Numeromancy is during the Redmoon cycle to resolve the Unobtainium bottleneck.

Strategic Synergies

The most powerful application of Numeromancy is during the Redmoon cycle to resolve the Unobtainium bottleneck.

  • The Redmoon Engine: By running a festival during the Redmoon cycle, you receive a base 2x boost to Unobtainium income. When combined with other endgame bonuses, this can reach nearly 2.5x total production.
  • Brewery Scaling: Each Brewery you construct increases the “Festival Cycle Bonus” by 1%. For example, having 50 breweries would increase the Redmoon festival bonus from 2.0x to 2.5x.
  • Temporal Arbitrage: Experienced players use a Chronoforge to “shatter” Time Crystals, skipping less profitable years to land precisely on the Redmoon cycle and maximise the Numeromancy festival bonus.

Why It Matters

Numeromancy is essential for the mid-to-late game transition (Phase 3 and 4). It transforms Festivals from simple happiness-boosting events into high-leverage tools for resource generation. This is particularly vital for reaching Transcendence Tier 15, as the faith income bonus in the Helios cycle and the Unobtainium boost in Redmoon accelerate the accumulation of Time Crystals and Relics.

item.description:
Megalomania is a mid-game Metaphysics upgrade that serves as the essential gateway to advanced religious structures and the “Unicorn Era”. It costs 10 Paragon to purchase.

By purchasing Megalomania, you gain access to high-tier structures and mechanics that are otherwise hidden:

  • Black Pyramids: These are necessary to attract Leviathans, allowing you to trade Unobtainium for Time Crystals and Relics.
  • Markers: These strange structures initiate the corruption process, which slowly transforms Alicorns into Necrocorns.
  • Black Codex: Unlocks further religious upgrades, such as the Unicorn Graveyard, which boosts your maximum culture based on the number of Ziggurats you possess.

  • Black Codex: Unlocks further religious upgrades, such as the Unicorn Graveyard, which boosts your maximum culture based on the number of Ziggurats you possess.

Acquisition Requirements

To unlock Megalomania in the Metaphysics menu, you must meet the following criteria:

  • Science Tech: Research the Metaphysics technology (55k Science and 5 Unobtainium).
  • Metaphysics Prerequisite: You must first purchase Enlightenment (formerly Engineering) for 5 Paragon.

Strategic Timing: When to Buy

While its cost is relatively low, strategic guides offer specific warnings regarding when to invest your Paragon:

  • The “Early Game Trap”: Megalomania is often considered a trap for new players. Because the structures it unlocks (like Black Pyramids) are “really expensive” and belong to the endgame resource line, it is not recommended for your first few runs.
  • Priority Order: You should prioritise all price ratio reduction upgrades—specifically Golden Ratio, Divine Proportion, and Renaissance—before buying Megalomania.
  • The 40k Run Exception: If you are attempting a very long run (such as the 40k years milestone), Megalomania is considered necessary to begin working toward Time Crystals as early as possible.

Role in the Unicorn Era

Megalomania is the catalyst for transitioning from simple unicorn gathering to a full Time Crystal engine. Once purchased, you can refine Unicorn Tears into Black Liquid Sorrow (BLS); five units of BLS allow you to build your first Black Pyramid, which officially begins the process of trading with Leviathans for the temporal resources we discussed previously, such as Anachronomancy and Chronospheres.

item.title: Golden Ratio
item.description:
Golden Ratio is an early-to-mid-game Metaphysics upgrade that reduces the price ratio of buildings on the Bonfire tab. By slowing down how quickly construction costs increase, it allows you to build significantly more structures before hitting your resource caps, which directly boosts your production and maximum kitten population.

Acquisition and Prerequisites

  • Paragon Cost: 50 Paragon.
  • Prerequisite: You must first purchase the Enlightenment metaphysics upgrade (5 Paragon).
  • Unlocks: Purchasing Golden Ratio is required to unlock Divine Proportion (100 Paragon).

Core Effects

  • Price Reduction: It reduces all price ratios by approximately 1.618%.
  • Mathematical Basis: The exact percentage reduction is derived from the mathematical golden ratio: $\frac{1+\sqrt{5}}{2}$.
  • Scope: Note that this price ratio reduction only applies to buildings found in the Bonfire tab; it does not affect space structures or other categories.

Strategic Utility

The Golden Ratio is considered a “price reduction meta” and is a cornerstone of efficient progression.

item.title: Burn your paragon
item.description:
Burning paragon is a mechanic that converts your standard unspent paragon into “burned” paragon. While burned paragon is less effective than regular paragon for production in the early game, it provides unique stacking bonuses and becomes significantly more powerful during the late-game “Dark Future” period.

Core Effects of Burned Paragon

  • Production Bonus: Burned paragon has approximately half the production effectiveness of regular paragon. However, it stacks with regular paragon, allowing you to bypass the diminishing returns that standard paragon faces after the 150–200 point threshold.
  • Storage Capacity:
    • Before Dark Future (Year 40,000): Each burned paragon provides a 0.05% storage capacity bonus (half of regular paragon’s 0.1%).
    • During Dark Future: Each burned paragon provides a 0.2% storage capacity bonus, making it twice as effective as regular paragon for increasing resource caps.
  • Leader Trait Bonus: Having burned paragon provides a slight boost to the effects of your kitten leader’s traits (such as Scientist, Artisan, or Manager).
  • Persistence: Like regular paragon, burned paragon is a permanent resource that carries over through all resets.

Deciding when to burn your stash depends on your current progression:

  • The 400-Point Threshold: A common strategy is to consider burning paragon once you reach 400 unspent points. At this stage, 400 burned paragon provides roughly the same production boost as 200 regular paragon, but because it stacks, it helps push production higher as standard paragon gains become marginal.
  • Storage Caps: Because burned paragon storage bonuses never diminish, they are essential in the late game for reaching the massive unobtainium caps (e.g., 8.14 billion) required for self-sustaining resets with 100 Chronospheres.
  • Preparation for Iron Will: For players attempting the “Insane” Space Oddity achievement, you must have less than 10 unburned paragon in your bank. Burning your paragon allows you to keep the production and storage benefits of your prestige without disqualifying yourself from the achievement.

Important Considerations

  • Wait for Metaphysics: It is generally recommended to prioritize purchasing price ratio reduction Metaphysics (like Golden Ratio, Divine Proportion, and Renaissance) before burning paragon.
  • Dark Future Milestone: Since the storage bonus quadruples during the Dark Future, burning paragon is a primary strategy for players planning “Endless Runs” or deep-space exploration.
  • Gold Star Space Oddity: Obtaining the Space Oddity gold star reward provides a permanent benefit: it allows you to burn paragon in the future without exiting Iron Will mode.

item.title: Adjustment Bureau
item.description:
The Adjustment Bureau is a low-cost Metaphysics upgrade that serves as the gateway to the Challenges system in Kittens Game. Once purchased, it unlocks a dedicated Challenges tab (separate from the Science tab), where you can activate specific game-altering restrictions in exchange for permanent global rewards.

Costs and Unlocks

  • Cost: 5 Paragon.
  • Unlocks: The Challenges menu and the secret ASCOH upgrade.
  • Prerequisites: You must first research the Metaphysics technology (which requires 55,000 Science and 5 Unobtainium) to access the Metaphysics purchase menu.

How Challenges Work

Challenges impose special handicaps that typically require a game reset to begin. When a challenge is active, Chronospheres will not bring resources into the run (unless it is the Post-Apocalypse challenge); instead, those resources are placed in reserves and can be reclaimed once the challenge is complete.

How Challenges Work

Challenges impose special handicaps that typically require a game reset to begin. When a challenge is active, Chronospheres will not bring resources into the run (unless it is the Post-Apocalypse challenge); instead, those resources are placed in reserves and can be reclaimed once the challenge is complete.

  • Rewards: Completing a challenge for the first time grants both a Base Reward and an Increasing Reward. Multiple challenges can be active simultaneously, and rewards for repeated completions stack.
  • Examples: Common challenges include Winter Has Come (endless winter), Anarchy (lazy kittens), and Atheism (no faith bonus).

Strategic Advice

  • Timing: Strategic guides suggest that you are generally not ready for the Adjustment Bureau and its challenges until you reach Phase 2 (mid-game). It is usually better to prioritise price ratio reduction upgrades (like Golden Ratio or Renaissance) before attempting challenge runs.
  • Iron Will Exception: You do not need to purchase the Adjustment Bureau to play in Iron Will mode. Iron Will is a “hidden” challenge that is triggered simply by resetting and playing without building any kitten housing.

item.content:encoded:
Anachronomancy is a pivotal mid-game Metaphysics upgrade that allows your civilisation to preserve its most advanced temporal assets across resets.

It is considered a mandatory requirement before a player begins focusing seriously on Time Crystals or deep-space exploration.

Costs and Prerequisites

  • Paragon Cost: 125.
  • Unlock Prerequisite: You must first purchase the Chronomancy metaphysics upgrade.
  • Technology Prerequisite: You must have researched the Metaphysics technology (which requires 5 unobtainium) to access the purchase menu.

Core Effects

The primary function of Anachronomancy is to change the rules of what carries over when you reset your game:

  • Time Crystal Preservation: Your stockpile of Time Crystals is saved. Without this upgrade, all Time Crystals are lost upon reset.
  • Chronophysics Persistence: The Chronophysics technology is saved across resets. Once you have both Anachronomancy and have researched Chronophysics once, you will start every future run with that technology already researched.

Strategic Importance

Anachronomancy is the gateway to the “Mid-Game” and the Relic/Time Crystal economy.

  1. Enabling Chronospheres: Since Chronophysics is the prerequisite for building Chronospheres, having it available at the start of a run allows you to begin using temporal mechanics much earlier in your progression.
  2. Unicorn Era Progression: It is essential for the “Unicorn Era,” where players sacrifice unicorns and alicorns to generate Time Crystals. Anachronomancy ensures that this effort isn’t wasted when you decide to reset for more Paragon.
  3. Efficiency Milestone: Strategic guides typically suggest purchasing Anachronomancy after you have secured primary price-reduction upgrades like Renaissance. It allows you to “experiment with time crystals” without the risk of losing your investment.

Summary of Carry-Over Mechanics

Resource/Tech Without Anachronomancy With Anachronomancy
Time Crystals Lost Saved
Chronophysics Must be re-researched Saved/Auto-Researched
Temporal Flux Saved Saved
Chronosphere Resources Depends on CS count Depends on CS count

Unicornmancy is a mid-to-late-game Metaphysics upgrade that increases the frequency of rare unicorn-related astronomical events. It is a critical component for players entering the “Unicorn Era”, as it accelerates the acquisition of Unicorns and Ivory, which are the foundational resources for generating Time Crystals and Relics.

Acquisition and Cost

To access Unicornmancy, you must first research the Metaphysics technology (requiring 5 Unobtainium) to unlock the Metaphysics purchase menu.

  • Paragon Cost: 125 Paragon.
  • Strategic Timing: Sources recommend purchasing Unicornmancy once you have secured your primary price-reduction upgrades (up to Renaissance) and are ready to begin serious progression into time manipulation.

Primary Effects

The upgrade provides a 10% increase to the daily chance of the following phenomena:

  • Unicorn Rifts: Random events enabled by Ivory Towers that grant a bulk amount of unicorns.
  • Ivory Meteors: Random events enabled by Ivory Citadels that provide a burst of ivory.

Synergies and Scaling

The benefits of Unicornmancy can be significantly amplified by late-game infrastructure:

  • Blazars: Each level of this Cryptotheology building improves the effectiveness of Unicornmancy by 2.5%.
  • Ivory Infrastructure: Because the frequency of Rifts and Ivory Meteors is fundamentally tied to the number of Ivory Towers and Ivory Citadels you possess, Unicornmancy becomes exponentially more valuable as your religious infrastructure grows.
  • Solar Revolution: While Unicornmancy increases the frequency of events, the Solar Revolution bonus is one of the only multipliers that boosts the actual production of unicorn resources.

Strategic Importance

In the late game, Ivory often becomes a major bottleneck because its production does not benefit from standard paragon or building bonuses. By increasing the frequency of Ivory Meteors, Unicornmancy provides a necessary “AFK” source of ivory. This allows you to build the vast numbers of Ziggurats required to refine Unicorn Tears and eventually trade with Leviathans for the resources needed to reach the “Infinity” stage of the game.

item.title: Astromancy
item.description:
In Kittens Game, Astromancy is an early-to-midgame Metaphysics upgrade that drastically accelerates astronomical events and early-game Starchart generation.

1. Cost and Prerequisites

  • Cost: 50 Paragon.
  • Prerequisite: Chronomancy (25 Paragon).

2. Core Effects

Astromancy doubles both the frequency and the automated success rate of astronomical events:

  • Doubles Astronomical Event Chance: Multiplies your base astronomical event chance and the event chance added by Observatories by 2\times\).
  • Doubles Observatory Effectiveness: Multiplies the automatic event observation chance provided by Observatories by 2\times\) (from +1% per Observatory up to +2% per Observatory).
  • (Note: It affects event chances and auto-observation rates, but does not double the science bonus or science cap of Observatories).

3. Strategic Impact

  • Reaching 100% Auto-Observation Faster: Normally, each Observatory adds +1% chance to automatically observe an event without manual clicking, requiring 100 Observatories to guarantee success. With Astromancy, each Observatory gives +2%, cutting the requirement down to only 50 Observatories before you achieve 100% automated success (prior to unlocking SETI).
  • Breaking the Starchart Bottleneck: In early space runs and resets, Starcharts are one of the most punishing bottlenecks needed to craft Trade Ships, unlock Geodesy, and fund early rocket launches. Pairing Chronomancy (+10% daily chance) with Astromancy 2 times chance) more than doubles your incoming Starcharts early in a run.
  • When to Buy: Community guides typically recommend purchasing Astromancy around your 3rd or 4th run (often alongside or shortly after Golden Ratio and Divine Proportion), right as you are preparing to push through early space missions and build up large Trade Ship fleets.

item.title: Chronomancy
item.description:
Chronomancy is a mid-game Metaphysics upgrade that serves as a vital bridge toward advanced temporal and astronomical technologies. It costs 25 Paragon to purchase and is primarily used to increase the frequency of celestial phenomena.

Core Effects and Unlocks

  • Event Multiplier: It provides a 1.1x multiplier to the daily chance of both meteors and astronomical events. The sources explicitly note that this is a multiplicative bonus to the base chance, not a flat +10% addition.
  • Technological Prerequisites: Purchasing Chronomancy is required to unlock two essential high-tier Metaphysics:
    • Anachronomancy: Allows Time Crystals and Chronophysics to persist across game resets.
    • Astromancy: Further doubles the chance of star events and increases the effectiveness of Observatories.

Strategic Utility

The value of Chronomancy depends on your current stage of progression:

Chronomancy is a mid-game Metaphysics upgrade that serves as a vital bridge toward advanced temporal and astronomical technologies. It costs 25 Paragon to purchase and is primarily used to increase the frequency of celestial phenomena.

Core Effects and Unlocks

  • Event Multiplier: It provides a 1.1x multiplier to the daily chance of both meteors and astronomical events. The sources explicitly note that this is a multiplicative bonus to the base chance, not a flat +10% addition.
  • Technological Prerequisites: Purchasing Chronomancy is required to unlock two essential high-tier Metaphysics:
    • Anachronomancy: Allows Time Crystals and Chronophysics to persist across game resets.
    • Astromancy: Further doubles the chance of star events and increases the effectiveness of Observatories.

Strategic Utility

The value of Chronomancy depends on your current stage of progression:

  • The Starchart Solution: In early runs where Starchart production is a bottleneck, the combination of Chronomancy and Astromancy is described as “pure magic”. It more than doubles event frequency, allowing you to build a larger fleet of Trade Ships for Titanium acquisition.
  • Late-Game Priority: In very advanced “Endgame” or “Iron Will” runs, some strategies suggest prioritising price-ratio reductions (like Renaissance) first, treating Chronomancy as a “less vital” upgrade to be picked up once your economic foundation is stable.

Advanced Synergies

The effectiveness of the Chronomancy bonus can be further amplified through late-game structures and upgrades:

  • Temporal Accelerators: These items in the Time tab improve Chronomancy’s time-related effects by 1.25%.
  • Blazars: As a Cryptotheology building, each Blazar improves Chronomancy effectiveness by 2.5%.
  • Observatory Integration: Within the Bonfire tab, Chronomancy is listed as an upgrade for the Observatory, specifically increasing the Astronomical Event Chance by the 1.1x multiplier.

item.title: Diplomacy
item.description:
Diplomacy is a low-cost entry-level Metaphysics upgrade that significantly accelerates your early-game trade and exploration by allowing you to discover other civilisations much sooner. It is widely considered one of the essential first purchases when you begin spending Paragon.

Core Effects and Costs

The basic Diplomacy upgrade costs 5 Paragon and provides the following immediate benefits:

  • Earlier Discovery: Civilisations can be discovered starting at Year 1 instead of the default Year 5.
  • Improved Relations: Your starting standing ratio with discovered races is increased by 10, meaning they are less likely to be hostile.
  • Hostility Mitigation: It reduces the number of Tradeposts required to negate Zebra hostility from 85 down to 58.

The Diplomacy Metaphysics Tree

Buying Diplomacy opens a progression path primarily focused on the specialised Iron Will mode and advanced navigation:

  • Improved Relations: Your starting standing ratio with discovered races is increased by 10, meaning they are less likely to be hostile.
  • Hostility Mitigation: It reduces the number of Tradeposts required to negate Zebra hostility from 85 down to 58.

The Diplomacy Metaphysics Tree

Buying Diplomacy opens a progression path primarily focused on the specialised Iron Will mode and advanced navigation:

Upgrade Cost (Paragon) Key Effect
Diplomacy 5 Discover races at Year 1; +10 standing ratio.
Zebra Diplomacy 35 10% of your Zebra cap stays when ending Iron Will mode.
Zebra Covenant 75 50% of your Zebra cap stays when ending Iron Will mode.
Navigation Diplomacy 300 Allows civilisation discovery as soon as you have Trade Ships.

Strategic Advice

  • Priority Purchase: Strategic guides recommend purchasing Diplomacy on your second run, alongside price-reduction upgrades like Golden Ratio.
  • The “Zebra Trap”: While Diplomacy itself is vital, the subsequent upgrades (Zebra Diplomacy and Zebra Covenant) are often described as traps for newer players. Keeping a small number of Zebras when transitioning out of Iron Will mode provides very little benefit for the high Paragon cost.
  • Starchart Synergy: By discovering races earlier and mitigating hostility faster, you can build a larger fleet of Trade Ships more efficiently, which helps overcome the mid-game Titanium bottleneck.

If you are currently on your first or second run, focusing on Diplomacy and the price ratio reduction upgrades (Enlightenment, Golden Ratio) will provide the most significant boost to your village’s growth.

item.title: Enlightenment
item.description:
Enlightenment is an entry-level Metaphysics upgrade that provides a permanent global reduction in building costs on the Bonfire tab., It is considered a foundational purchase because it slows the rate at which building prices increase, allowing you to build more structures before hitting resource caps.

Costs and Unlocks

  • Cost: 5 Paragon.
  • Unlocks: Purchasing Enlightenment is a prerequisite for several critical branches of the Metaphysics tree:
    • Price Reduction: Unlocks Golden Ratio.
    • Religious/Unicorn Mechanics: Unlocks Megalomania.,
    • Crafting: Unlocks Codex Vox.

Core Effects

  • Price Ratio Reduction: It reduces all building price ratios by 1%.
  • Persistent Bonus: Like all Metaphysics upgrades, Enlightenment is permanent and carries over through game resets, though the “Metaphysics” technology itself must be re-researched in each new run to access the menu.,

Strategic Timing
